videos.title: The McKenzie Break
videos.description: During World War II, German POWs are imprisoned in Camp McKenzie in the Scottish Highlands. Led by their fanatical Nazi captain, the interns make life intolerable for the camp commander, who sends for an army intelligence officer to help control the situation. The new military arrival soon discovers that the disruptions in the camp are merely a cover for an imminent breakout attempt.

videos.title: Death Train
videos.description: Thriller about a United Nations operative who must prevent the shipment of a nuclear bomb. A dissident Russian general aims to restore his country to superpower status by arranging the covert delivery of the bomb, in the hope that the former Soviet army would be reconvened to cope with the nuclear threat.

videos.title: Case Sensitive
videos.description: Concluding episode of the detective drama based on Sophie Hannah's novel. When Ruth Blacksmith leaves her husband for troubled musician Aidan Harper, the love triangle results in tragedy. As DS Charlie Zailer investigates with the help of her prickly junior, DC Simon Waterhouse, she uncovers a past of thwarted ambition and murderous jealousy.

videos.title: The Lady Vanishes
videos.description: Beautiful, young socialite Iris Carr, bored with the raucous and unsociable behaviour of her friends whilst on holiday, resolves to seek out some tranquillity and travel home alone. Iris' expectations of peace are short-lived when, at the railway station, she suddenly faints. She wakes in time to be rushed onto the train, but with a pounding head and a feeling of being in a dream.

videos.title: The Assassination Bureau
videos.description: In 1906, a secret international club eliminates those they deem unworthy. Their leader, in an attempt to rejuvenate the group, challenges his assassins to target him, while he in turn will attempt to assassinate them. The scene is set for a cat-and-mouse chase across Europe, which is further complicated by the presence of a beautiful female reporter.
